trigger: Root directive explicitly required live UDA and source-first independent claim checking.

controls.required: Inspect original page images; retain conditions, alternatives, glyph uncertainty, exact scope and author disagreement.
controls.failure: Unsupported attribution or guessed glyph; source wording mixed with inference.
controls.repair: Reopen specific image and narrow or mark uncertainty.
controls.enforcement: semantic; per-source-page notes and exact hash

controls.required: Freeze source-first notes before reading report/ledger; freeze diagnosis before rationale or repair history.
controls.failure: Source-first or diagnosis-first record follows disallowed exposure.
controls.repair: Disclose contamination and obtain fresh context if consequential.
controls.enforcement: read receipt and file hashes; diagnostic authority only

controls.required: Apply these controls at source freeze, diagnosis freeze, and focused addendum.
controls.failure: Read-as-checked substituted for actual passage check.
controls.repair: Check candidate at point of use and bind evidence.

controls.required: Historical horary source meaning only; no participant, personal-fit or empirical-accuracy claims.
controls.failure: Participant inputs accessed or historical doctrine called predictive evidence.
controls.repair: Remove unsupported claim and disclose boundaries.

limitations: Fresh same-model context, bounded independent diagnosis; not cross-family or empirical validation. Root owns owner clock and delivery.
